httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta may fetch URLs from memo content.

Two distinct categories of outbound HTTP to user-provided URLs have been identified.

Webhook URLs are configured by users and delivered through `webhook.Post()` → `safeClient.Do(req)`. Link metadata URLs are provided per RPC request and fetched via `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta()` → `httpClient.Get(urlStr)`.

value.text: Checking whether RPC handlers trigger outbound HTTP requests via httpgetter image fetching, and examining AI service code for user-configured URLs.

The focus is on RPC handlers that transitively trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs.

Two categories of user-configured URLs were identified. Webhook URLs set through CreateUserWebhook or UpdateUserWebhook trigger outbound POSTs via webhook.Post() and webhook.PostAsync(). Memo lifecycle events drive this path. GetLinkMetadata and BatchGetLinkMetadata accept URLs directly in the RPC request rather than from persistent user settings.

UpdateUserSetting and SSO SignIn were ruled out as direct HTTP triggers. SSO IDP URLs are admin-configured, not user webhook URLs. AI Transcribe uses an admin AI provider URL. TestInstanceEmailSetting sends SMTP emails rather than HTTP to user URLs. Webhooks remain the primary user-configured URL mechanism.

`webhook.Post()` is the convergence point for webhook URLs. `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta()` is the convergence point for link metadata URLs, calling `httpClient.Get(urlStr)`.

The singular convergence point requirement points to the webhook system. CreateMemo and UpdateMemo both route through dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook and dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects into webhook.PostAsync, converging immediately before delivery at webhook.Post().

DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations also converge at webhook.PostAsync and webhook.Post. CreateMemoComment routes through both memo comment creation and internal memo creation. CreateUserWebhook and UpdateUserWebhook store webhook URLs without triggering outbound HTTP. GetLinkMetadata and BatchGetLinkMetadata pass user-supplied URLs directly to httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta.
Checking batch memo operations for webhook triggers. Verifying gRPC service registration to confirm exact RPC method names from the proto definitions.

Clarifying the exact convergence function for the identified RPC handlers.

The convergence function is `Post()`, where `http.NewRequest` and `safeClient.Do(req)` execute. `PostAsync()` enqueues the work but does not perform the actual HTTP delivery.

Link metadata follows a separate path through `GetHTMLMeta`. Verifying that `store.GerWebhooks` sources the target URL from user configuration.
